sources.title: Develop generative AI apps on Microsoft Foundry - Training
sources.snippet: Explore complementary strategies to optimize generative AI model performance. Learn how to apply prompt engineering, ground your model with RAG, and fine-tune for consistent behavior—and when to combine these approaches.

sources.title: Improving Retrieval and RAG with Embedding Model Finetuning
sources.snippet: Fine-tune embedding models on Databricks to enhance retrieval and RAG accuracy with synthetic data—no manual labeling required.

sources.title: Foundry Models | Microsoft Azure
sources.snippet: Accelerate generative AI development with Foundry Models that are packaged for out-of-the-box use. Fine tune AI using models as a service (MaaS).

sources.title: RAFT: Adapting Language Model to Domain Specific RAG
sources.snippet: RAFT builds on top of RAT, and generalizes beyond APIs for RAG applications. The RAFT model is trained on top of the base model Llama2-7B from Meta and on Microsoft AI Studio. We provide a short tutorial on how to train your own RAFT model for RAG applications. For more details about RAFT please refer to our paper and Microsoft-Meta blog.

sources.title: RAG Vs Fine-Tuning for Enhancing LLM Performance
sources.snippet: Data Science and Machine Learning researchers and practitioners alike are constantly exploring innovative strategies to enhance the capabilities of language models. Among the myriad approaches, two prominent techniques have emerged which are Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Fine-tuning.
